# Stride

## What it is
A web app for a local running club: see this week's group runs, sign up for one, and see who else is going.

## Who it's for
Club members aged 20 to 60, from beginners to marathon runners, mostly checking on their phones on the way out of the door.

## Platform
A React web app (phone first, also used on laptops).

## Brand
The club's colour is a bright orange; no logo yet. No required fonts.

## Feel
Energetic, friendly, encouraging, clear.

## Apps they like
Strava's activity feed, and how simple Meetup's event pages are.

## First screens
A welcome page that says what the club is and how to join, sign-in, and a home screen listing this week's runs.

## Content

Show exactly this content on these screens: no more items, no fewer, no other actions. How it looks and is laid out is up to you.

### Welcome (/)

- Page title: Stride Running Club
- Main line: Run together this week.
- Supporting line: Pick a group run, sign up in a tap, and see who else is going.
- Three short points:
  - Group runs every week, for every pace
  - Beginners welcome: nobody runs alone
  - Free for club members
- Button: Join the club
- Line for existing members: Already a member? with the link: Sign in

### Sign in (/sign-in)

- Title: Sign in
- Helper line: Welcome back. Sign in to see this week's runs.
- Field: Email (type: email)
- Field: Password (type: password)
- Button: Sign in
- Link: Forgot password?
- Line: New here? with the link: Join the club
